title: One orchestrator and precise PR trigger admission
proposed_changes: Introduce one PR orchestration workflow selecting FAST, PACKET or FINAL_HEAD from changed files.
Retain exactly one canonical complete-suite check per final head.
Convert historical release and gate workflows to workflow_call, workflow_dispatch, precise path filters or push-to-main verification.
Add per-PR concurrency with cancel-in-progress true.
Keep tiered FAST and PACKET checks focused; prevent tiered FINAL_HEAD from duplicating the canonical complete suite.
Record mutable run IDs after candidate seal in a receipt/control branch.
Batch branch updates and push one coherent candidate.
Use one CI completion evaluator that inspects required checks once.
Add an admission preflight ensuring required contexts will trigger for the proposed changed paths.
Fail closed when required-check workflow path or app identity does not match the ruleset registry.
acceptance_preconditions: Exact workflow paths and app identities
Measured critical path and queue times for every run
No changes to test assertions or application semantics
Operator approval before workflow or ruleset mutation
rollback: Restore prior workflow triggers through a new non-destructive commit; preserve baseline and all decisions.
